about: A toolkit programmers use to build bots that crawl websites and collect data from them.

prs.title: Sitemap pages wrapped in extra spacing are no longer lost
prs.broken: A sitemap is a file listing a site's pages for crawlers. When a page address had spaces or line breaks around it in a quoted block, the tool kept the space instead, dropped the page, and could crawl nothing.
prs.changed: The tool now ignores bits of text that are only spaces or line breaks.
prs.matters: Crawls that start from these sitemaps visit every page they list.

prs.title: One broken sitemap no longer loses the pages from the others
prs.broken: A sitemap lists a site's pages for crawlers. If one sitemap had an error, like a single unescaped character, the tool threw away every page it had found, often without any message.
prs.changed: The error is now logged and the tool moves on to the next sitemap.
prs.matters: Crawls keep the pages from every good sitemap and show which one was broken.

prs.title: Requests sent through a proxy now really use the proxy
prs.broken: When a crawler sent an extra request and asked for a proxy, the proxy setting was dropped and the request went out directly.
prs.changed: The proxy setting is now passed along, and the one given for that request wins over the session's proxy.
prs.matters: Crawls that must go through a proxy no longer leak requests from the real address.
